thread:
Marta (Content): Hey team — we recorded the case interview with Carver Health this morning. Transcript attached and short clip timestamps: 00:00–01:20 (problem), 02:10–02:45 (value), 07:30–08:10 (quote). Need quote approval and final top-line for the launch post. :sparkles:

Leo (PMM): Nice! Can you drop the single-sentence quote you want on the landing? I can craft the headline copy once quote is locked.

Jules (Producer): Uploaded raw audio + rough cut to the Drive here: https://redwood.app/drive/case-carver. Thinking 60–90s hero clip for social. Need final approved quote by EOD Wed to hit our publish window.

Anya (AE): Heads up — Carver asked that any marketing outreach tied to the case study route inbound leads to their AM team first. We need the lead routing tag updated before the webinar CTA goes live. @ops-bot can we add routing rule?

ops-bot: @Anya noted. Please confirm the routing key format. Current standard: lead_source=customer_case, account_tier=enterprise. Reply with the full string to apply.

Anya (AE): Use: lead_source=carver_case, account_tier=enterprise, owner=carver-am-team. That way HubSpot fires to their queue and we can track conversions separately.

Sam (Legal): I skimmed the transcript. Two quick asks: 1) remove an operational metric that Carver flagged (customer count by region) — replace with "significant month-over-month growth"; 2) approve the short quote but redact a single vendor mention. If Marta posts the revised quote thread, I can sign off.

Marta (Content): Got it — proposed hero quote for approval: "Redwood helped us cut inference costs 3x while keeping latency steady — it unlocked new product workflows for our ML teams." Edited: "cut inference costs significantly while keeping latency steady" to avoid the metric. Also removed vendor mention.

Leo (PMM): That reads well. Small tweak: swap "keeping latency steady" -> "without sacrificing latency". So final: "Redwood helped us cut inference costs significantly without sacrificing latency — it unlocked new product workflows for our ML teams."

Sam (Legal): That wording is fine. I approve with the redaction noted. Sam (Legal) — approved. :white_check_mark:

Jules (Producer): Copy that. I'll send the social clips + landing draft to design. Marta, can you confirm the headshot and job title for attribution? Also, Anya — please confirm the HubSpot routing spec so I can wire the CTA button.

Anya (AE): Headcount + title confirmed: "Jordan Carver, VP of ML — Carver Health". HubSpot tag payload: {"lead_source":"carver_case","account_tier":"enterprise","owner":"carver-am-team","campaign":"carver_case_launch_2026"} — please use the exact campaign key.

Marta (Content): Thanks. I'll update the landing copy and drop the final quote into the doc. Will tag @Sam for legal final sign-off once it's in place.

ops-bot: Routing rule applied to QA environment. Reminder: verify live environment 1 hour before publish.

Leo (PMM): Plan for webinar tie-in: 4/12 date, CTA on case page to register -> triggers demo request with routing above. Putting this on the release checklist. :calendar:

Marta (Content): Perfect. Closing loop — quote approved by legal, routing queued. I'll push draft to design and circle back with final assets by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
